reply.summary: Raceo is a cheerful green-skinned teen who can become any creature he can picture, and cracks jokes while doing it. A serum his parents gave him in a fever changed his body for good.

feats.scene: Raceo turns into an elephant and flattens a fence in one stampede.
As a rhino he takes a tank shell on his brow and shakes his head clear.
He swoops as a falcon over a canyon faster than a speeding train.

reply.summary: Orele is a young actor with a green complexion who can reshape his cells into any animal he has studied. A borrowed gift from a friend's blood lets him copy not only the shape but the skills.

feats.scene: Orele becomes a bull and bursts a steel gate off its posts.
In the form of a hippo he sits through a crashing truck.
He sprints as a cheetah across a parking lot.

reply.summary: Numtan is an adopted son of a team of oddball rescuers, able to turn into any beast for as long as he likes. Danger arrives daily and he meets it with fur, scales or feathers.

feats.scene: Numtan takes the shape of a gorilla and wrenches a door off a bank vault.
As a crocodile he shrugs off a fall from a high ledge.

reply.summary: Iumcoros is a once-heroic teen whose pledge to a demon lord twisted him into a clawed, fanged conqueror with milk-white eyes. Fire and stone swallowed him in a collapsing cavern.

feats.scene: Iumcoros swings a clawed fist and cleaves a cavern wall into rubble.
He weathers a fiery pit's heat and a tower of falling rock for a full minute.

reply.summary: Rnrnu is a secret green-haired adventurer from a series of short cartoons, who shifts into animals to fight crime between burping fits. His comic timing is as sharp as his claws.

feats.scene: Rnrnu becomes a bear and bats a runaway robot into a wall.
He bounces up from a crushing fall as a springy frog.

reply.summary: Iaolu is a young hero who channels a living web of animal energy, turning his skin green and letting him become any creature. Orphaned early and tugged between guardians, he finds that changing shape cannot fix pain inside.

feats.scene: Iaolu becomes a titanic beast and rams a collapsing overpass aside.
As a heavy reptile he holds up under a falling girder.
He dives as an eagle and crosses a bay in seconds.

reply.summary: Irnseter is a tiny, big-eyed cartoon prankster who slips between panels of a comic book to tell jokes. When a sneeze flings him into another world, he helps clean up the mess.

feats.scene: Irnseter turns into an ant and drags a toy crate across a table.
He gets flattened by a page turn and pops back into shape.

reply.summary: Numvaian lost the gift of changing shape and was stuck in the body of an ape inside a city that turned out to be a vast mental projection. He helped a band of oddballs trace the dream back to its maker.

feats.scene: Numvaian swings from a girder and knocks a guard flat.
He lands from a rooftop leap and climbs straight back up.

reply.summary: Soresi is a hardened shapechanger from a grim possible future who commands wild animals and scorns shame. He lives under another name and quietly mentors those who still use humour to stay human.

feats.scene: Soresi becomes a charging mammoth and tramples a line of armoured cars.
In bear form he takes a barrage of rifle fire and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Ruscorser is a young man cured of a fever by a doctor's serum, which let him unzip his own blood and rebuild himself as a tiger or any other beast. The living web of animal life behind it all seems to be calling him.

feats.scene: Ruscorser pounces as a tiger and bowls a gunman through a doorway.
He survives a wall collapse in his beast shape.
He runs down a speeding motorcycle on foot.

reply.summary: Rneri is a masked fire-starter in a hand-drawn rendition of a rain-slicked city, wielding a suit of burning gear and a flamethrower. Fire is the only language he enjoys.

feats.scene: Rneri torches a warehouse roof until the rafters fall.
His heat suit survives a blazing gas explosion.

reply.summary: Arulsiu is a serial arsonist who started as a trainee rescuer and was thrown out of the program for mishandling explosive materials. He now takes contracts from the mob and burns anything that pays.

feats.scene: Arulsiu rigs a flying tent with propellant and brings it down in a fireball.
He staggers out of his own burning car with scorched sleeves.

reply.summary: Miavosna is a former film-effects expert who sees visions in flames and wears a flame-throwing flight suit, striking at the wealthy of a poor city. Raised in an orphanage, he never learned to be wanted.

feats.scene: Miavosna swoops over a rail yard and sets a whole row of carriages alight.
His armoured suit absorbs a rooftop tumble and a nearby blast.
He banks around a bell tower in his jet pack.

reply.summary: Tircosia is a flamethrower-toting pilot summoned to a gathering of rogues by a mischievous imp. In the cramped hall she tripped over a rival's frost gun and knocked herself out.

feats.scene: Tircosia fires her flamer and scorches the ceiling of a convention hall.
She shrugs off a few punches before the frost beam lays her flat.

reply.summary: Vantotes is a seven-foot performing ape, drilled by outside handlers to hunt a champion and fetch a defector. Freed from his cage at last, he returns to the grasslands where he belongs.

feats.scene: Vantotes pulls a hotel window frame from its brick and tosses it aside.
He absorbs a series of electric shocks and still rises to his feet.

reply.summary: Corrnuval is a tall, scrawny deckhand with a mild voice and an iron nerve, adopted by two adventurers on a smuggler hunt. Foes who take him for a fool find a razor at their throat.

feats.scene: Corrnuval slashes with a straight blade and cuts a rope holding a cargo net over a thief.
He takes a heavy blow from a crate and finishes his cooking.

reply.summary: Lorre is a crook who lost most of his hearing and sight to a blast, and now wears electronic ears and infra-red goggles lent by a scheming inventor. He flies a twin-engined plane and sabotages tests of new coatings.

feats.scene: Lorre drops a bomb from his plane onto an experimental paint shed.
He gets bundled out of his cockpit and stays in one piece.

reply.summary: Sestrn is a masked villain who appeared once and vanished, a carved-stone nightmare that haunted a team of explorers. Little is known of his plans beyond the scare he caused.

feats.scene: Sestrn throws a stone block from a parapet at passing adventurers.
His stone mask cracks but holds under a hammer blow.

reply.summary: Stisinel is a green-skinned, red-eyed alien would-be conqueror who tests advanced weapons on a foreign planet. His grand story of exile turned out to be a lie told for a distant tyrant.

feats.scene: Stisinel fires a lunar base cannon and levels a few city blocks.
He survives an orbital laser blast that obliterates his ship.

reply.summary: Telvalval is a pink-skinned warrior queen conjured out of a space-romance novel by a pyromaniac's imagination, with a sword and few words. She came to life to fight a monster and left a lasting mark on a crew of time travelers.

feats.scene: Telvalval cleaves a monster's tentacle with one sword stroke.
She stands in a monster's crushing grip and breaks free.

reply.summary: Relenile is a gangster who ran a deadly scheme to unmask a famous warrior, shooting a pilot along the way. Cornering a librarian in her workplace, he found the very woman he hunted waiting.

feats.scene: Relenile empties a pistol into a reading-room door.
He takes a hard bruising punch and goes down.

reply.summary: Nolvalti was a red-eyed, hairless ring bearer guarding a distant sector, and a parent of three. He gave his life shielding the young children of strangers from a deadly attack.

feats.scene: Nolvalti forms a glowing wall and slams it into an onrushing horde.
His shield holds a full minute under heavy fire before it gives way.

reply.summary: Torerusa is a blond inventor and army scientist who works on experimental living-metal robots at a remote research base. He shares a laboratory, and a family name, with a rival brother.

feats.scene: Torerusa switches on a test rig and a robotic arm lifts a steel plate.
He stands behind a blast screen while a prototype overheats.

reply.summary: Orivanus is a green-skinned, white-haired sea youth who must return to water or weaken, able to command waves and lift great weight. He finds every shore a puzzle and every tide a friend.

feats.scene: Orivanus calls up a wave and washes a pier clean off its pilings.
He takes a hard impact against a sea wall and swims away.

reply.summary: Sauoroau is a purple-eyed undersea diplomat who studied spell-craft and once fought as a young hero. Grief over a lost love sent him home to speak for his people at a human council.

feats.scene: Sauoroau calls a storm and a whirl of lightning sinks a gunboat.
He endures deep-sea pressure and a blast from a rival caster.

reply.summary: Necor is a black-haired sea warrior in a warped timeline who serves a ruthless king and fights hand to hand with trained, brutal skill. His loyalty is his only comfort.

feats.scene: Necor drives a fist through a wooden hull and floods the hold.
He takes a spear thrust to the ribs and swims on.

reply.summary: Serelis is a schoolchild from a coral kingdom, who dries out faster than any land dweller and hangs out in a treehouse built on a reef. He gives his friends a tour and shows them how to eat dessert underwater.

feats.scene: Serelis splashes a friend across a reef pool with a flick of his hand.
He tumbles through a cluster of coral and laughs.

reply.summary: Ticoel is a red-haired young man who gained control over lightning when strange storm beasts attacked his family's stranded ship. He is the restless heart of a far-future team and always seems to be searching for something.

feats.scene: Ticoel calls a bolt down from a cloud and fells a stone tower.
He takes an electric surge that would melt a cable and glows brighter.

reply.summary: Saeosor is a founding member of a far-future band of youths, one of a pair of twins who can control and drink in electric charge. He wears a flight ring and has a large family left behind.

feats.scene: Saeosor channels a bolt through a metal gate and blows it apart.
He absorbs a power-line surge and releases it back as a flash.

reply.summary: Nieoval is a younger duplicate of a far-future hero, born from a time paradox and later erased. He fights with electric arcs and a flight ring.

feats.scene: Nieoval forks a lightning arc between two rooftops and burns out an antenna array.
He absorbs a stun beam that drops a squad of guards.

reply.summary: Rnillril is a chibi-style lightning wielder who travels to the past with friends to fetch a genius for an emergency that turns out to be a birthday party. He is cheerful and bounces around.

feats.scene: Rnillril zaps a toy robot and sends it spinning across a rug.
He is bonked by a party balloon and giggles.

reply.summary: Amteel is a pink-skinned, stone-bodied alien from a peaceful world of rock people who became a married officer of the law. He raises a young son and works long shifts in a rowdy mercenary force.

feats.scene: Amteel punches through a vault wall and drags out a thief.
He takes a collapsing ceiling on his shoulders and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Torrnmia is a pink-skinned, hairless stage wrestler with claws, one half of a tag team in an interdimensional league. The bouts are scripted but the slams are genuine.

feats.scene: Torrnmia drops an iron-armed move on a rival and cracks the ring boards.
He gets thrown through three ropes and bounces back up.

reply.summary: Resco is a loyal gang henchman who was nicknamed by his boss and never got to insist on his real name. Shot once and stabbed once, he kept standing up for the crew.

feats.scene: Resco swings a pipe at an enemy boss and lands a clean hit.
He gets shot in the chest, is rushed to surgery and returns to duty.

reply.summary: Rivarseo is a dark-haired prankster who runs deadly puzzle games for his own amusement, and once worked for a clown boss. Players enter his contests and rarely leave on their own terms.

feats.scene: Rivarseo springs a trapdoor that drops a contestant into a pit.
He survives a scuffle with a pair of angry players.

reply.summary: Eruiasnti is a professional thief who commands the wind and works for a sinister master. A gale from his hands scatters guards and papers alike.

feats.scene: Eruiasnti whips up a gust that tears a roof off a shed.
He rides a crash landing out of a thermal and walks away limping.

reply.summary: Lasco is a restless ghost of a double-dealing spy killed during a covert mission, carried inside another man's body as the first of many souls. Anger lets him seize the body to settle an old score.

feats.scene: Lasco takes control of his host and fires a pistol at a former rival.
Cast out of the body, he drifts apart and still lingers.

reply.summary: Teneo is a kind-hearted party clown who was mocked for his height but never lost his decency. He was spared in a terrible night and kept going through the aftermath.

feats.scene: Teneo tugs a door handle that is just out of reach and has to ask for help.
He stays upright in a witness box through hours of questions.

reply.summary: Tesse is a masked extremist in a fringe militia who uses canisters of poison vapour in crowded buildings. Respirator hissing, he waits for the panic to thin the guards.

feats.scene: Tesse vents a canister and empties a government hallway.
His sealed mask and suit protect him through a thick cloud.

reply.summary: Rneeruau is a thug who hisses knockout vapour from a backpack tank, working smash-and-grab jobs from a van. Guards fall asleep in doorways while he fills his sack.

feats.scene: Rneeruau opens a valve and drops three guards in a hallway.
He takes a tackle and keeps his tank intact.

reply.summary: Toranlis is a fallen winged being with an ironic sense of humour, once sent to guard a mortal woman and later to recover her soul from a silent realm. He crews a ghost ship through the afterlife.

feats.scene: Toranlis spreads his wings and a ray of pale light sweeps a hall of shades to ash.
He stands calmly at the heart of a collapsing citadel.

reply.summary: Tonaute is a winged dream-creature who once played nightmares and fled to the waking world, longing to inspire rather than frighten. Her dark hair shifts in shades of blue and violet when she changes shape.

feats.scene: Tonaute reshapes a hallway into a tangle of black vines.
She holds together after a fall from a dreamlike spire.

reply.summary: Nteruno is a grey-haired, blustering politician and old soldier who rails about borders and conspiracies, idolising a violent veteran. His campaign speeches fill stadiums and his secrets fill folders.

feats.scene: Nteruno raps a podium so hard that the microphone jumps.
He stands through a day of rallies and a thrown bottle.

reply.summary: Linnaiu is a courteous knight and nephew of a legendary king, known across many retellings by a handful of names. His honour is famous, and his descendants carry a rich name into a later age.

feats.scene: Linnaiu splits an iron shield in a single sword stroke.
He fights on through a field of arrows, held up by his armour.

reply.summary: Nelrerar is a hardworking woman who spent years in prison for a death she did not cause, then rebuilt her life running a gym that restores patients' strength. She funded it by demanding every unpaid hour from her old boss.

feats.scene: Nelrerar swings a paperweight and drops an intruder.
She endures a long stretch of hard labour and wakes up the next day.

reply.summary: Rumtinte is a white-haired mad scientist from a doomed world who built a quake engine to bring it down. His punishment was the longest exile in a silent prison between worlds.

feats.scene: Rumtinte switches on his engine and cracks a continent-sized fault line.
He is seized by guards and dragged away without a bruise.

reply.summary: Orsan is a teenage girl who teleports and shares a body with a boy as one fused hero. Held captive as a power source, she escaped through a forest and called her partner her boyfriend before ever being asked.

feats.scene: Orsan blinks above a gunship and drops a boulder through its rotor.
She takes a heavy shock from her captors and recovers by dawn.

reply.summary: Tateolu is a white-haired deity of an undersea pantheon, once a keeper of order, who shifts gender and shape at will and opens paths between realms. Seduction is their favourite weapon and charm their best spell.

feats.scene: Tateolu opens a gate between worlds and a flood of golden fire sweeps an avenue clean.
They stand untouched as a sea-god's wrath breaks over them.

reply.summary: Rauore is a stretchy shape-shifting spy from a heroic mirror world who impersonates a rival to infiltrate her enemies. She rallies her team to help strangers escape.

feats.scene: Rauore stretches an arm across a hall and shoves a guard through a window.
Her rubbery body takes a heavy blow and snaps back.

reply.summary: Uneruamo is a black-haired criminal who can reshape her body into any person or beast, inheriting a dead mother's talent and a grudge. She framed a green hero for crimes, then helped a gang flatten a coastal city.

feats.scene: Uneruamo drops a hulking creature onto a coastal city and levels its districts.
In an armoured beast shape she takes a heavy beating and walks away.
